skill.name: nex-einvoice-fr
skill.description: A public guide to French e-invoicing readiness, covering mandate timing, Factur-X, platform selection, invoice statuses, and e-reporting planning.
skill.summary: Outline French e-invoicing readiness using a short guide and an illustrative PME reporting example.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: French e-invoicing preparation requires coordinating finance obligations, invoice formats, and platform decisions. This guide organizes those topics and provides a PME timing example for initial planning.
actual_capabilities: Identifies business size and VAT regime as inputs for mandate and reporting discussions.
Provides a PME example separating invoice receipt readiness from invoice issuance timing.
Introduces Factur-X and its relationship to EN 16931 for integration planning.
Highlights the distinction between rejected and refused invoices in lifecycle workflow planning.
Identifies B2C and cross-border reporting, plus PA/PDP selection, as readiness workstreams.
limitations: Only the public guide is included; scripts, extension source, and templates are explicitly excluded.
The file advertises technical mapping and decision trees but does not include detailed mappings or executable workflows.
Regulatory claims reference June 2026 without official citations; verify dates and reporting rules against current authoritative sources.
The guide does not replace EN 16931, Peppol BIS 3.0 documentation, or professional tax advice.

use_cases.title: Prepare a finance readiness checklist
use_cases.description: Separate receipt readiness, issuance timing, and reporting questions before confirming obligations with a tax adviser.

use_cases.title: Scope an ERP integration
use_cases.description: Identify Factur-X specifications, platform interfaces, and lifecycle handling requirements that need detailed documentation.

use_cases.title: Organize reporting questions
use_cases.description: Collect business size, VAT regime, and transaction types for a structured e-reporting discussion.
use_cases.target_user: Accountants advising retailers and independent businesses

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the French e-invoicing topics in this guide. Separate included information from advertised materials that are missing.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a readiness checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Our business is a French PME using the reel normal VAT regime. Draft a readiness checklist from the guide. Mark regulatory claims requiring verification.

prompt_templates.title: Scope platform selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft PA/PDP selection questions for a French retailer with B2C and cross-border sales. Distinguish guide content from additional recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Build an integration discovery plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ERP integration discovery plan covering Factur-X, EN 16931, and rejected versus refused invoices. Identify missing specifications and validation evidence.

output_examples.input: What does the guide say about a French PME using the reel normal VAT regime?
output: The guide gives September 1, 2026 for receipt readiness and September 1, 2027 for issuance.
It describes B2C reporting in ten-day periods, with transmission within ten days after each period.
These are guide claims, not independently verified deadlines. Confirm applicability and current rules before implementation.

output_examples.input: Is this package enough to implement Factur-X in our ERP?
output: No. The guide names Factur-X and EN 16931 but supplies no detailed field mapping or validation tooling.
Obtain the relevant standards and platform interface documentation before designing the integration.
Include rejected and refused invoice handling in workflow discovery.

best_practices: Confirm current obligations with official French tax guidance and a qualified adviser before using dates operationally.
Provide business size, VAT regime, and transaction types when requesting a readiness outline.
Use authoritative format specifications and platform documentation to validate any proposed ERP mapping.
anti_patterns: Treating the guide as a certified compliance engine or legal determination.
Assuming advertised scripts, templates, and detailed decision trees are included in this folder.
Applying the PME example to every business size or VAT regime without checking applicability.

faq.question: What does this package contain?
faq.answer: It contains one SKILL.md public guide with topic summaries, limitations, and an illustrative PME reporting example.

faq.question: Does it submit invoices or reporting data?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed file contains no submission code, API integration, or automated reporting workflow.

faq.question: Are the regulatory dates independently verified?
faq.answer: No. The guide references June 2026 but provides no official citations. Check current authoritative guidance before relying on its examples.

faq.question: Does it include complete Factur-X specifications?
faq.answer: No. It introduces Factur-X and EN 16931 but does not include detailed mappings or replace the underlying standards.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this guide?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The package is Markdown guidance, not a bundled integration for those tools.

faq.question: Does it select or connect a PA/PDP?
faq.answer: No. It identifies platform selection as a planning topic but includes neither a complete decision tree nor a platform connector.
